content.caption: Red cross mark icon used in the WikiSkill ablation table to indicate that wiki access is disabled for a component.
content.description: The picture is a small, bold red 'X' (cross mark) on a plain white background. It is made of two thick diagonal strokes that cross at the centre. It contains no text, arrows or other elements. In the page context (Table 3, an ablation study on WikiSkill using Gemini-3.5-Flash), this red cross appears in the 'WikiSkill Components' columns, 'Inference Agent Wiki Access' and 'Skill Proposer Wiki Access'. It means the component does NOT have wiki access during skill evolution, as opposed to the green check mark, which means access is enabled. When the Skill Proposer carries a cross, the Wiki Maintainer is also removed, so no persistent knowledge accumulates across iterations. In the table, the cross appears under Skill Proposer Wiki Access in the rows averaging 45.3 (Inference Agent checked) and 48.7 (both crossed). It appears under Inference Agent Wiki Access in the rows averaging 48.7 and 63.7. The 63.7 row is the default WikiSkill configuration, where the Inference Agent is crossed and the Skill Proposer is checked.
